name: size-context
title: Size Context
description: React context provider for the two-step size ladder (36px default, 28px compact). Controls control heights, text, icon, and padding scale across all Fluid Functionalism components, and ships the six-role type scale (size + leading per role) with its class map.
docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/sizes. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#sizes.
